verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Work mode carries a larger task through to a reviewable result (docs-28), and the desktop app runs projects in parallel and keeps long-running work moving (docs-32). Goal mode supports long-running work (docs-71), voice can start separate tasks and check their progress (docs-13, docs-51), Work can delegate to subagents (docs-103), and scheduled tasks run in the background with completed runs available for review (docs-37). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background task delegation, and detailed documentation of how Goal mode works and how results are returned for review.
